verdict.rationale: The README documents installing through a plugin marketplace (`/plugin marketplace add` and `/plugin install`), which is a channel that could carry updates. Nothing in the evidence describes how updates are delivered; the other documented install methods (copying the skill folder, uploading a zip) all imply reinstalling manually to get fixes. missing for 10: documented marketplace auto-update behaviour, an explicit update command or upgrade instructions, versioning/changelog guidance, independent corroboration.
